title: Just Dyes
description: Removes the wooden palette from dyes
body:
# **Just Dyes**
 

This resource pack completely removes the wooden palettes from all of the 16 individual coloured dye textures as it doesn't make much sense as to why they are there. This makes them more similar to the older pre-1.21.9 textures, but with the new fresher 2025 textures.
